title: A world brought into order.
paragraphs: Genesis 1 describes God creating the heavens and the earth, bringing light, order, and life into a world described as formless and empty. Across six days, God separates and names, fills the sky, sea, and land, and repeatedly calls creation good.
Humanity is created in God's image, male and female, and given responsibility within creation (Genesis 1:26–28). The chapter closes with God seeing everything he has made as very good (Genesis 1:31).
